Add to your order

How long is it?

This isn't a 30-second voice note. I'm a yapper and I won't shut up. Think of it as your own private podcast episode, where I go deep on your exact question: what I'd do, why, and what I'd watch out for.

What will I actually get?

You get your own personal dashboard. I break your question into sections and record a separate voice note for each one, so you can listen, take notes and come back to it.

For example

"I've got an offer I know is good, but I can't sell it out. I'm posting every day and it's not turning into sales."

  1. Your buyer's journey, and where people are dropping off
  2. Your offer, and whether it's clear what changes for them
  3. Your content, and why it's getting attention but not sales
  4. What I'd do next, in order
How do I ask my question?

Once you check out, your confirmation email will include a form with a few prompts to help you get your question out. Your private dashboard is emailed to you within 1 to 2 business days.

Jess, the one who kept the doc

Who kept the doc

Hi, I'm Jess.

Business strategist, mindset coach and founder of Woman Mastery HQ™. I help women work out what will grow their business, then deal with the part where they know what to do and still find 14 reasons to do something else.

For seven years, I've kept a document of the things I wasn't ready to say out loud.

The slow sales weeks. The prices I nearly talked myself out of charging. The days I wanted to burn it all down, followed by the slightly awkward realisation that I still wanted this.

I wrote down what happened, what I made it mean and what helped me move forward.

That document became my playbook. The doc itself stays private. Off the Record is 33 audios I recorded from it, for you. The first time I'm opening it up for anyone else.

Big love,
Jess xo

Quick answers

How do I listen?

In your private Off the Record dashboard. Listen whenever you like, in whatever order you like.

How long is each audio?

Between 8 and 10 minutes each.

I listen to your podcast, Voice Message, Sent. What's the difference?

The podcast is what I'm happy to say in public. Off the Record is what I wrote down when nobody was watching.

Voice Message, Sent. is made for anyone who presses play. These audios come straight from the 7-year private doc: the money decisions, the prices I nearly didn't charge, the weeks I wanted to quit, and exactly what I did next. It's the unfiltered version, with the real reasoning left in. You won't hear any of it on the podcast. Not on the podcast. Never will be.

When do I get access?

Access opens on 30 November. Grab your spot now and you'll get an email the moment your private Off the Record dashboard is live.

What happens once I pay?

You'll get a confirmation email from Kajabi straight away. On 30 November you'll get another email, and you can access the audios from there. If you have any issues, or it doesn't arrive within 24 hours, email jessica@jessicapinili.com.

Is this for me if I'm just starting out?

If you're running a business and you've had a hard week, a quiet sales day or a moment you wanted to quit, there's something in here for you.
